Subject: Re: VAT treatment for platform & reseller fees

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the certificate. Looping in Marissa (payments) and Ben (tax ops) to confirm process and required evidence.

High-level options we typically support for marketplace / reseller flows:

1) Reverse-charge (recommended for B2B EU):
   - We need a validated EU VAT ID for the buyer entity (VIES check or equivalent).
   - Invoice will be issued net of VAT with the standard reverse-charge note (article reference + local text).
   - You should be able to account for the VAT under the reverse-charge rules in your country.

2) Gross invoice / self-billing by reseller:
   - If TwoFish (reseller) prefers to collect and remit VAT, we can issue a gross invoice to the reseller entity.
   - Requires reseller entity’s VAT registration and confirmation they will handle VAT.

3) Split invoicing (platform net + reseller margin):
   - We can produce separate invoice lines (or two invoices) so your GL mapping is easier.
   - This is what most customers who run a marketplace choose when they need clear cost-of-goods vs platform fee lines.

What we need from you to enable reverse-charge today: full legal entity name, billing country, VAT number (we have the certificate but we need the exact registration string), and a billing contact for any compliance follow-up. If VIES fails, we will ask for secondary proof (company registration extract).

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm the validation steps and whether we should hold payment (temporary 30-day suspension) if the VAT ID fails validation? Also attaching a sample split invoice we can send if TwoFish prefers that path (attachment: invoice-sample-redwood.pdf).

Jonas Weber

Thanks for the details, Jonas. Summary of the validation and billing steps from Payments/Tax Ops:

1) VAT ID validation flow:
   - First pass: VIES lookup (automated).
   - If VIES returns false/timeout: manual review against provided certificate and company registry extract.
   - Logged evidence is stored in our compliance bucket and cross-referenced with invoice.

2) Payment hold policy:
   - If the buyer VAT ID fails validation and we cannot reasonably validate within 5 business days, we put invoices into a 30-day suspense hold for remediation.
   - For active large accounts (enterprise/partners) we typically allow a 7-business-day remediation before hold; we can apply the same exception for TwoFish if agreed.

3) Invoice formatting & split lines:
   - We can produce either (A) a single invoice with itemized lines: PLATFORM_FEE (net, reverse-charge) + RESELLER_MARGIN (gross) or (B) two separate invoices — whichever you prefer.
   - When reverse-charge is applied we add the clause: "VAT reverse-charged under Article 44 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC" plus the local language snippet for the buyer country.

I've attached our internal validation log template (attachment: vat-validation-log.csv) showing required fields we stamp into the invoice metadata. Please confirm the exact VAT number string (including country prefix) and the legal name for the invoicing entity so we can push this live.
